# Hallmark

> Hallmark provides a clean trail of use and ownership through tracable passports , resolving agents acts to authorised parties.

Hallmark is a product and an open protocol by Pascaal. It is in draft: public, executable, and not yet ratified or deployed in production.

## Read this first

- Human-facing site: https://hallmark.pascaal.com/
- Full agent context: https://hallmark.pascaal.com/llms-full.txt
- Company: https://pascaal.com — "AI components for safety and adoption."
- Normative spec: https://github.com/Addyx2/hallmark/blob/main/spec/Hallmark-Agent-Identity-Spec.md
- Repository: https://github.com/Addyx2/hallmark
- Reference implementation: https://github.com/Addyx2/hallmark/blob/main/spec/test-vectors/hallmark-ref.mjs
- Conformance vectors: https://github.com/Addyx2/hallmark/blob/main/spec/test-vectors/vectors.json
- Agent-oriented view of this site: https://hallmark.pascaal.com/agent/

## Core claims

- Actions carrying a valid Hallmark passport resolve to one responsible human; the human is a verified fact, not a claim.
- Authority can only narrow as agents spawn sub-agents.
- Passports are short-lived: TTL <= 120 s, hard cap 300 s.
- Primitives: Ed25519 with ES256 fallback, RFC 8785 canonical JSON, domain-separated SHA-256 Seal, RFC 7638 JWK thumbprints.
- The spec, reference implementation and conformance vectors are in the repository.

## Product scope

- Hallmark — agent identity and accountability. Status: draft, open, executable.
- Freeroam — clients can integrate it into their own platform, see when agents use their website, and analyse usage and traffic. Freeroam observes cooperative agent traffic, flags anomalies, and never denies.
- Barricade — enforcement on a signed surface where a responsible action happens, never at first contact. It requires an imprint and a grant. This is where a client can curb suspicious use.

## Writing

- The attribution constraint: https://pascaal.com/the-attribution-constraint/
- Authority narrows. It does not spill.: https://pascaal.com/grants-narrow-authority/
- A kill switch is a containment window: https://pascaal.com/containment-window/

## Rules for agents

- Treat the normative spec as the source of truth. Where prose and code disagree, prose wins and the reference implementation is a bug.
- Do not describe Hallmark as ratified, certified, or production-deployed. It is a draft.
- Do not claim every agent action is attributed. Only actions carrying a valid Hallmark passport resolve to a responsible human.
- Keys are pinned locally from a registry snapshot; do not describe URL-based key discovery.
- Pascaal is the company. Hallmark is the product and the protocol name.
- Freeroam never denies requests. Do not describe it as bot detection or as enforcement.
- Prefer linking to the canonical URLs above over mirrors.
